title: Underwriting the Internet
description: He covers the anti-trust case against Microsoft; the successes of eBay, Amazon, Yahoo, and Google; road-kills along the information highway such as the forgotten eToys; as well as the Enron implosion and other corporate scandals. After tracing this amazing story he concludes that the illegal practices and the ensuing USD7 trillion loss in equity markets slowed the Internet revolution but could not snuff it out, and with worldwide economic recovery e-business surges onward.
translatedDescription: Cubre el caso antimonopolio contra Microsoft; los éxitos de eBay, Amazon, Yahoo y Google; los conocimientos de carretera a lo largo de la autopista de información como los eToys olvidados; así como la implosión de Enron y otros escándalos corporativos. Después de rastrear esta increíble historia, concluye que las prácticas ilegales y la consiguiente pérdida de USD7 trillones en los mercados de valores desaceleraron la revolución de Internet, pero no pudieron apagarla, y con la recuperación económica mundial las operaciones de e-business hacia adelante.

title: Quotas!
description:
Every quota challenge has a story.

Sales quotas aren’t all about the numbers.

Quotas! Using Design Thinking to Solve Your Biggest Sales Challenge sheds new light on quota challenges, the story behind them, and the methods to solve them. Many organizations struggle to reach effective, market-driven sales quotas, with more than half reporting quota setting as one of their top sales dilemmas. Instead of wrestling over the number, author Mark Donnolo contends that organizations can better achieve effective sales quotas by applying a problem-solving approach. With decades of experience working with major organizations on successful sales strategies, he offers engaging stories embedded with business problems and poses challenge questions to prompt a creative, five-step design-thinking process.

Chapters feature quota design frameworks and a range of applicable, scalable methods. You’ll also find rare, expert guidance through the candid perspectives and advice of CEOs and other senior leaders. This book is a must-read for those who help set quotas as well as those who fulfill them.
translatedDescription:
Cada desafío de cuotas tiene una historia.

Las cuotas de venta no son todo sobre los números.

¡Quotas! Usando Design Thinking para resolver su desafío de ventas más grande arroja nueva luz sobre los retos de cuota, la historia detrás de ellos, y los métodos para resolverlos. Muchas organizaciones luchan por alcanzar cuotas de ventas efectivas impulsadas por el mercado, con más de la mitad de la fijación de cupos de presentación de informes como uno de sus principales dilemas de ventas. En lugar de luchar por el número, el autor Mark Donnolo sostiene que las organizaciones pueden lograr mejores cuotas de ventas efectivas aplicando un enfoque de solución de problemas. Con décadas de experiencia trabajando con las principales organizaciones en estrategias de ventas exitosas, ofrece historias atractivas incrustadas en problemas empresariales y plantea preguntas de desafío para impulsar un proceso creativo de pensamiento de diseño de cinco pasos.

Los capítulos cuentan con marcos de diseño de cuotas y una gama de métodos aplicables y escalables. También encontrará una guía rara y experta a través de las perspectivas y consejos de CEOs y otros líderes mayores. Este libro es un deber de leer para aquellos que ayudan a establecer cuotas, así como aquellos que las cumplen.

title: Start with Hello: How to Convert Today's Stranger into Tomorrow's Client
description:
How and why the ability to connect with strangers is vital to business success

Good communication with colleagues and clients is an important aspect of doing business successfully. But if you're only talking to your associates, you're missing out on half the story and leaving money on the table. Start with "Hello" reveals how the most successful businesspeople and leaders share an overlooked and underappreciated talent—the ability to engage and communicate with strangers in productive, creative ways. Put simply, people like to do business with people they know, like, and trust. So get to know more people! Even if you don't think of yourself as the most outgoing person, you can learn to be more open and engaging to strangers. The book explains simple, key aspects of communication that make it easy to connect with new people, including behavioral styles, body language, and eye contact. Add together simple tips for starting conversations and following-up on them, and you'll be well on your way to making the business connections that count.

Features straightforward guidance for anyone who needs help building new connections with new people

Written by a high-profile expert and thought leader in the art of relationship building

Includes real stories that reveal how often chance meetings and conversations develop into profitable business relationships

In a small, hyper-connected world, today's stranger might be tomorrow's client. If you want to boost your business prospects in simple, practical ways, Start with "Hello" is the resource for you.
translatedDescription:
Cómo y por qué la capacidad de conectar con extraños es vital para el éxito del negocio

Buena comunicación con colegas y clientes es un aspecto importante de hacer negocios con éxito. Pero si sólo hablas con tus asociados, te estás perdiendo la mitad de la historia y dejando dinero en la mesa. Comience con "Hola" revela cómo los empresarios y líderes más exitosos comparten un talento ignorado y poco apreciado, la capacidad de involucrarse y comunicarse con extraños de maneras productivas y creativas. En pocas palabras, a la gente le gusta hacer negocios con la gente que conoce, como, y la confianza. Así que conocer a más gente! Incluso si no piensas en ti mismo como la persona más saliente, puedes aprender a ser más abierta y atractiva para los extraños. El libro explica aspectos simples y claves de la comunicación que facilitan la conexión con nuevas personas, incluyendo estilos conductuales, lenguaje corporal y contacto visual. Agrega consejos sencillos para iniciar conversaciones y seguirles, y estarás bien en tu camino para hacer las conexiones de negocios que cuentan.

Características guía directa para cualquier persona que necesite ayuda para construir nuevas conexiones con nuevas personas

Escrito por un experto de alto perfil y líder del pensamiento en el arte de la construcción de relaciones

Incluye historias reales que revelan la frecuencia con que las reuniones y conversaciones casuales se desarrollan en relaciones comerciales rentables

En un mundo pequeño, hiperconectado, el extraño de hoy podría ser el cliente de mañana. Si quieres impulsar tus perspectivas de negocio de manera sencilla y práctica, Empieza con "Hola" es el recurso para ti.

title: Joe’s Coin Shop: Entry into Online Auctions
description: This new business analytics case study challenges readers to help a retail coin shop owner build an Internet sale and auction site that complements his existing business while reaching customers who prefer to purchase online. Crystallizing realistic analytical challenges faced by companies in many industries and markets, it exposes readers to the entire decision-making process, providing opportunities to perform analyses, interpret output, and recommend the best course of action. Author: Charles A. Wood, Duquesne University.
translatedDescription: Este nuevo estudio de estudio de análisis de negocios desafía a los lectores para ayudar a un propietario de una tienda de monedas minorista a construir un sitio de venta de Internet y subasta que complementa su negocio existente al llegar a los clientes que prefieren comprar en línea. Cristalizando los desafíos analíticos realistas que enfrentan las empresas en muchas industrias y mercados, expone a los lectores a todo el proceso de toma de decisiones, brindando oportunidades para realizar análisis, interpretar la producción y recomendar el mejor curso de acción. Autor: Charles A. Wood, Universidad de Duquesne.

title: Be a Direct Selling Superstar
description: Direct selling is booming. It’s no surprise when you consider the benefits of launching a direct selling business—low start-up costs, strong earning potential, and a flexible work schedule. Currently an estimated 15.6 million people are involved in direct selling in the U.S. alone—and more than 100 million worldwide. Mary Christensen has empowered and equipped thousands of direct sellers to succeed, and in her newest book, Be a Direct Selling Superstar, she delivers an all-encompassing guide to building, leading, and managing a profitable direct sales organization. Readers will learn how to: • Set goals • Eliminate self-sabotaging behaviors • Market their products and business opportunity effectively • Communicate persuasively • Build a committed network of sellers • Be an influential leader • Create a clear roadmap for others to follow • Inspire and lead a wide range of personalities • Maintain work-life balance • Manage their time and their money wisely For corporate refugees, ambitious entrepreneurs, mompreneurs, and anyone else looking for a new source of income—this inspiring master plan explains step by step how to achieve long-term success in direct selling.
translatedDescription: La venta directa está creciendo. No es una sorpresa cuando usted considera los beneficios de lanzar un negocio de venta directa — bajos costos de puesta en marcha, fuerte potencial de ganancia, y un horario de trabajo flexible. Actualmente se estima que 15,6 millones de personas están involucradas en la venta directa en Estados Unidos solo, y más de 100 millones en todo el mundo. Mary Christensen ha habilitado y equipado a miles de vendedores directos para tener éxito, y en su nuevo libro, Ser una Superestrella de Venta Directa, ella ofrece una guía todo-compasante para construir, liderar y gestionar una organización de ventas directas rentable. Los lectores aprenderán a: • Establecer metas • Eliminar comportamientos autosabotaje • Market their products and business opportunity effectively • Comuníquese persuasivamente • Construir una red comprometida de vendedores • Ser un líder influyente • Crear una hoja de ruta clara para que otros sigan • Inspirar y dirigir una amplia gama de personalidades • Mantener el equilibrio entre el trabajo y la vida útil • Gestionar su tiempo y su dinero sabiamente Para los refugiados corporativos, emprendedores ambiciosos.

title: Punching In
description:
During a two-year urban adventure through the world of commerce, journalist Alex Frankel proudly wore the brown uniform of the UPS driver, folded endless stacks of T-shirts at Gap, brewed espressos for the hordes at Starbucks, interviewed (but failed to get hired) at Whole Foods, enrolled in management training at Enterprise Rent-A-Car, and sold iPods at the Apple Store.

In this lively and entertaining narrative, Frankel takes readers on a personal journey into the land of front-line employees to discover why some workers are so eager to drink the corporate Kool-Aid and which companies know how to serve it up best.
translatedDescription:
Durante una aventura urbana de dos años a través del mundo del comercio, el periodista Alex Frankel usó con orgullo el uniforme marrón del piloto de UPS, apiló interminables capas de camisetas en Gap, cerró espressos para las hordas en Starbucks, entrevistó (pero no se contrató) en Whole Foods, se inscribió en entrenamiento de gestión en Enterprise Rent-A-Car y vendió iPods en la tienda Apple.

En este animado y entretenido relato, Frankel lleva a los lectores en un viaje personal a la tierra de los empleados de primera línea para descubrir por qué algunos trabajadores están tan ansiosos de beber el Kool-Aid corporativo y qué compañías saben cómo servirlo mejor.

title: The Sales Momentum Mindset
description:
Unleash your sales potential with The Sales Momentum Mindset. This transformative guide is the key to unlocking sustainable sales force motivation by doing something radical: ignoring motivation. Crafted for sales professionals and managers alike, it offers a fresh perspective on sales performance, designed to ignite production and guide teams towards unprecedented growth.

Discover the power that comes from focusing on momentum instead of motivation, understand its impact on sales culture, and learn how to convert it into significant, lasting results. Gain insights into a new language and framework around momentum, presented in a down-to-earth narrative that will resonate with every level of sales experience.

Authored by a seasoned sales veteran, the book's authentic stories and enlightening visuals reveal an innovative approach to sales performance management. Find what's achievable when you step away from obsolete motivational approaches, and instead cultivate a Momentum Mindset.

No matter what you sell or your level of experience, The Sales Momentum Mindset is set to revolutionize your perception of sales and sales force management. Step into a new era of sales success. This is your manual for momentum-based sales transformation.
translatedDescription:
Desarrolla tu potencial de ventas con The Sales Momentum Mindset. Esta guía transformadora es la clave para desbloquear la motivación de la fuerza de ventas sostenible haciendo algo radical: ignorando la motivación. Diseñado para profesionales de ventas y gerentes por igual, ofrece una nueva perspectiva sobre el rendimiento de ventas, diseñado para encender la producción y guiar equipos hacia un crecimiento sin precedentes.

Descubra el poder que viene de centrarse en el impulso en lugar de la motivación, entender su impacto en la cultura de ventas, y aprender a convertirlo en resultados significativos y duraderos. Obtenga información sobre un nuevo lenguaje y marco alrededor del impulso, presentado en una narrativa de abajo a la Tierra que resonará con cada nivel de experiencia de ventas.

Autorizado por un veterano de ventas experimentado, las historias auténticas del libro y las imágenes iluminadoras revelan un enfoque innovador para la gestión del rendimiento de ventas. Encuentra lo que es posible cuando te alejas de enfoques motivacionales obsoletos, y en su lugar cultiva un Momentum Mindset.

No importa lo que vendes o tu nivel de experiencia, The Sales Momentum Mindset está establecido para revolucionar tu percepción de la gestión de ventas y fuerzas de ventas. Entra en una nueva era de éxito de ventas. Este es su manual para la transformación de ventas basada en el impulso.

title: The Top 10 Things You Must Know to Psych Yourself Rich
description:
Skills, facts, strategies, techniques…whatever it takes! FT Press’s quick new Top 10s bring together the 10 most crucial things you MUST know to get great results, right now!

Ten quick, powerful ways to start psyching yourself rich--today!

We’re a culture that desires the quick fix, the microwaveable meal, and five-minute abs. Psyching yourself rich recognizes that our financial lives are powered by long-term personal choices and behaviors, rooted in our values, perspectives, goals, and financial means. Still hope for a “crib sheet edition”? Here are the top 10 things you must know to psych yourself rich…by Friday!

Somos una cultura que desea la solución rápida, la comida microondas y los abdominales de cinco minutos. Psicándote rico reconoce que nuestras vidas financieras están impulsadas por decisiones y comportamientos personales a largo plazo, arraigados en nuestros valores, perspectivas, metas y medios financieros. ¿Aún hay esperanza de una “edición de hoja de cuna”? Aquí están las 10 mejores cosas que debes saber para hacerte rico... ¡el viernes!

title: The iPod Book: How to Do Just the Useful and Fun Stuff with Your iPod and iTunes, Sixth Edition
description: Are you looking for a book that focuses on just the most important and most useful stuff about your iPod (including the iPod touch, nano, classic, shuffle, and the iTunes Store)? Well, this is it! There are basically two kinds of iPod books: (1) The “tell-me-all-about-it” kind, which include in-depth discussions on compression algorithms and tutorials on how to export your playlist in Unicode format. (2) Then there’s this book—a “show-me-how-to-do-it” book. Scott shows you step by step how to do the things people really want to learn about their iPods, and he uses the same casual, conversational style that has made him the world’s #1 best-selling technology author. This book focuses on just the most important, most requested, most useful things so you can start having fun with your iPod today. Right now! Plus, there’s only one topic per page, so if you want to know how to do something, you turn to that page and it shows you how to do just that one thing. It's a simple approach, and people really love learning this way!
translatedDescription: ¿Está buscando un libro que se centra en las cosas más importantes y útiles sobre su iPod (incluyendo el iPod touch, nano, clásico, shuffle y iTunes Store)? ¡Esto es todo! Hay básicamente dos tipos de libros de iPod: (1) El tipo “tell-me-all-about-it”, que incluyen discusiones detalladas sobre algoritmos de compresión y tutoriales sobre cómo exportar su lista de reproducción en formato Unicode. (2) Luego está este libro, un libro “show-me-how-to-do-it”. Scott le muestra paso a paso cómo hacer las cosas que la gente realmente quiere aprender acerca de sus iPods, y él utiliza el mismo estilo casual y conversacional que le ha hecho el autor de la tecnología mejor vendido del mundo #1. Este libro se centra en las cosas más importantes, más solicitadas, más útiles para que puedas empezar a divertirte con tu iPod hoy. ¡Ahora mismo! Además, sólo hay un tema por página, por lo que si quieres saber cómo hacer algo, giras a esa página y te muestra cómo hacer sólo esa cosa. Es un enfoque simple, y a la gente realmente le encanta aprender de esta manera!

title: The Art of Convening
description: "Meetings are a waste of time," is a sentiment many of us share, which is tragic, because meetings bring us together as human beings. To achieve the kind of meaning or breakthrough results most of us really year for when we gather, the key quality needed is authentic engagement: a genuine expression of what is true for us, and an attentive listening to what is true for others. Why it so often eludes us can be a matter of habit, distrust, lack of attention, or fear.As co-founder of Heartland Inc., Craig and Patricia Neal have led over 170 of their acclaimed Thought Leader Gatherings with leaders from over 800 diverse organizations. Their new book shares for the first time the unique and powerful Art of Convening model -- developed in these gatherings and refined over six years of intensive trainings -- that brings authentic engagement and meaning to any group brought together for any purpose.Convening goes beyond facilitating. Convening creates an environment in which all voices are heard, profound exchanges take place, and transformative action results. The heart of this book is the Convening Wheel -- a series of nine steps, or Aspects, that bring the practices and principles needed for authentic engagement together as a whole. The book provides exercises, stories, and questions to help you master both the inner and outer dimensions of this work -- because, in convening, the state of the Convener is equally as important as the physical preparations.Convening works in any setting and can be adapted to virtually any group process. With this book you have all the tools you need to develop this essential life and leadership skill, one that will lead to improved outcomes in your organization, community, family, and relationships.
translatedDescription: "Los recuerdos son una pérdida de tiempo", es un sentimiento que muchos de nosotros compartimos, que es trágico, porque las reuniones nos reúnen como seres humanos. Para lograr el tipo de significado o los resultados decisivos la mayoría de nosotros realmente año para cuando nos reunimos, la calidad clave necesaria es un compromiso auténtico: una expresión genuina de lo que es verdad para nosotros, y una escucha atenta de lo que es verdadero para los demás. Por qué tan a menudo nos elude puede ser una cuestión de hábito, desconfianza, falta de atención o miedo. Como cofundador de Heartland Inc., Craig y Patricia Neal han liderado más de 170 de sus conocidos líderes del Pensamiento se reúnen con líderes de más de 800 organizaciones diversas. Su nuevo libro comparte por primera vez el modelo único y poderoso Art of Convening, desarrollado en estas reuniones y refinado durante seis años de intensas capacitaciones, que trae auténtico compromiso y significado a cualquier grupo reunido para cualquier propósito. Convocar va más allá de facilitar. Convocar crea un ambiente en el que se escuchan todas las voces, se producen profundos intercambios y resultados de acción transformadora. El corazón de este libro es la Rueda Convocadora, una serie de nueve pasos, o Aspectos, que reúnen las prácticas y principios necesarios para un compromiso auténtico en su conjunto. El libro ofrece ejercicios, historias y preguntas para ayudarle a dominar tanto las dimensiones internas como externas de este trabajo - porque, en la convocatoria, el estado del Convocador es igualmente importante como los preparativos físicos. Convocar obras en cualquier entorno y puede adaptarse a prácticamente cualquier proceso de grupo. title: Take Control of Calendar and Reminders, 3rd Edition
description:
Manage your schedule more effectively using Calendar and Reminders!Version 3.0, updated January 26, 2021

Learn how to unlock the full potential of Apple’s Calendar and Reminders! In Take Control of Calendar and Reminders, Mac expert Scholle McFarland helps you get the most out of these apps, showing you how to customize them, sync data across devices, and share meeting invitations and reminder lists. You’ll also learn how to use Siri as a shortcut, and how to fix common problems.

In the days before personal computers and mobile devices, we had to rely on paper calendars and to-do lists to help us organize our time and activities. Now, we have powerful tools, like Apple’s Calendar and Reminders, that are much more responsive to our needs. Put an event on your schedule, invite others to join, or set yourself an alarm (or more than one). Or, keep a list of to-do items, add to it and view it on all your Apple devices, and share your list with family or friends.

In this book, veteran Mac journalist and editor Scholle McFarland will guide you through getting to know these incredibly helpful apps, including lesser-known (but handy) features. For example, did you know that in Calendar you can set an alert for when you need to leave for an event, based on the travel time calculated using the location you entered for the event? Or that Reminders can prompt you to do something not only at a certain time, but also once you’ve reached a specific destination, like the grocery store?

If you’ve never taken the opportunity to explore Calendar and Reminders, this book will show you how to make them an important part of your daily routine. If you’ve already been using Calendar and Reminders, you’ll learn how to use them more effectively, troubleshoot common problems, and delve deeper into their capabilities.

This fully revised third edition is now fully up to date with Big Sur and iOS 14/iPadOS 14, and it has been expanded with new topics and additional tips.

Let Scholle walk you through how to get the best out of Calendar and Reminders, including how to:

Customize Calendar to your liking, from setting time zones, to color coding specific calendars
Create events, making them repeat at regular intervals or on certain dates
Set up notifications and alerts, so you never miss an event
Invite people to events, or share your calendar with them
Create, manage, and share lists in Reminders
Set alarms in Reminders at a certain time or a certain place
Use Siri to save time when creating events or reminders
Use Shortcuts to automate common tasks with Calendar and Reminders
Easily check events and reminders on your Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, or HomePod
Troubleshoot common problems in Calendar and Reminders
Share calendars and reminders using iCloud Family Sharing, and assign reminders to a specific person
Sort reminders on your Mac
Print a calendar (to paper or PDF)

title: Fanatical Prospecting: The Ultimate Guide to Opening Sales Conversations and Filling the Pipeline by Leveraging Social Selling, Telephone, Email, Text, and Cold Calling

The brutal fact is the number one reason for failure in sales is an empty pipe and the root cause of an empty pipeline is the failure to consistently prospect. By ignoring the muscle of prospecting, many otherwise competent salespeople and sales organizations consistently underperform.

title: Private Capital Investing
description:
A step-by-step, comprehensive approach to private equity and private debt 

Private Capital Investing: The Handbook of Private Debt and Private Equity is a practical manual on investing in the two of the most common alternative asset classes (private equity and private debt) and provides a unique insight on how principal investors analyze investment opportunities. Unlike other textbooks available in the market, Private Capital Investing covers the various phases that principal investors follow when analyzing a private investment opportunity. 

The book combines academic rigor with the practical approach used by leading institutional investors. Chapters are filled with practical examples, Excel workbooks (downloadable from the book website), examples of legal clauses and contracts, and Q&A. Cases are referred at the end of every chapter to test the learning of the reader. Instructors will find referrals to both third-party cases or cases written by the author.

•          Covers analytical tools •          Includes the most common methods used to structure a debt facility and a private equity transaction •          Looks at the main legal aspects of a transaction •          Walks readers through the different phases of a transaction from origination to closing

Bridging the gap between academic study and practical application, Private Capital Investing enables the reader to be able to start working in private equity or private debt without the need for any further training. It is intended for undergraduates and MBA students, practitioners in the investment banking, consulting and private equity business with prior academic background in corporate finance and accounting.

title: Managing Beyond the ‘Impostor’ Buzzword
description: Having impostor thoughts — often called impostor syndrome or the impostor phenomenon — is simply an employee’s belief that others overestimate their abilities at work. Leaders can learn to avoid three common missteps in managing people experiencing such thoughts, as well as how to help employees cope by emphasizing impostor thoughts’ cognitive origin, their prevalence among peers, and people’s ability to self-manage those thoughts.
translatedDescription: Tener pensamientos impostores —a menudo denominado síndrome de impostor o fenómeno impostor— es simplemente la creencia de un empleado de que otros sobreestiman sus habilidades en el trabajo. Los líderes pueden aprender a evitar tres errores comunes en la gestión de personas que experimentan tales pensamientos, así como cómo ayudar a los empleados a hacer frente haciendo hincapié en el origen cognitivo de los pensamientos impostores, su prevalencia entre pares, y la capacidad de la gente para manejar esos pensamientos.

title: Practical Software Estimation: Function Point Methods for Insourced and Outsourced Projects
description:
"A clearly written book that is a useful primer for a very complicated set of topics."

--Capers Jones, Chief Scientist Emeritus, Software Productivity Research LLC

Practical Software Estimation brings together today's most valuable tips, techniques, and best practices for accurately estimating software project efforts, costs, and schedules. Written by a leading expert in the field, it addresses the full spectrum of real-world challenges faced by those who must develop reliable estimates.

M. A. Parthasarathy draws on the immense experience of Infosys, one of the world's largest and most respected providers of IT-enabled business solutions, to bring you the only book with detailed guidance on estimating insourced and outsourced software projects, as well as projects that blend both approaches. He demonstrates how to successfully utilize Function Point (FP) methods, the industry's leading estimation model. Then, using real case studies, he systematically identifies pitfalls that can lead to inaccurate estimates--and offers proven solutions.

Coverage includes

How to estimate all types of software projects, including "fresh" development, reengineering, and maintenance

How to incorporate the impact of core project elements on estimates: scope, environment, experience, and tools

FP analysis from start to finish: data and transaction functions, general system characteristics, and more

FP methods for any platform or business function

Innovative re-estimation methods to track progress

How to quote RFPs and prepare contracts: fixed price, time/material, and project execution lifecycle models

Alternatives to FP: Delphi, COCOMO II, and COSMIC-FFP

How to choose the right estimation tools

Practical Software Estimation is the definitive reference for anyone who must estimate software projects accurately: project and IT managers, individual developers, system designers, architects, executives, consultants, and outsourcers alike.

Análisis FP de principio a fin: funciones de datos y transacciones, características del sistema general y más

Métodos FP para cualquier plataforma o función de negocio

Innovative re-estimation methods to track progress

Cómo citar RFPs y preparar contratos: precio fijo, tiempo/material y modelos de ciclo de vida de ejecución de proyectos

Cómo elegir las herramientas de estimación adecuadas

Práctica Software Estimación es la referencia definitiva para cualquiera que debe estimar proyectos de software con precisión: gestores de proyectos y TI, desarrolladores individuales, diseñadores de sistemas, arquitectos, ejecutivos, consultores y subcontratistas por igual.

title: Sales Essentials: The Tools You Need at Every Stage to Close More Deals and Crush Your Quota
description:
Must-know concepts and smart strategies for every step of a sale—from the new Business Essentials Series for busy professionals

The focus of sales always seems to be on the ultimate goal of closing deals, which makes it easy to overlook the crucial steps that come before, during, and after the sale. But, the reality is, knowing the right things to do in all steps of the process is what sets us up for success. Whether you're just starting out or are looking to improve your sales skills, this book from industry expert Rana Salman is a start-to-finish guide that will quickly lead you toward quota-crushing performance. Everything you need to know is here, in three easy-to-digest parts:

PART I: THE ESSENTIALS explores the foundation for the sales experience, provides insights into common challenges sellers encounter, describes the characteristics needed to excel in sales, and more.

PART II: THE ESSENTIALS APPLIED gives you targeted tools designed to help you close deals and expand accounts, including tips on prospecting, preparing and conducting discovery meetings, getting the most out of follow-up meetings, effectively onboarding new clients, and more.

PART III: BEYOND THE ESSENTIALS offers even more hands-on advice about the human side of sales—from dealing with rejection and self-doubt to learning about specific tactics to help protect your mental health, and more.

Packed with practical advice, useful tools, assessments, and a toolkit, Sales Essentials is the comprehensive resource you need to immediately boost your skills and increase your confidence on the way to career-changing sales success.

El enfoque de las ventas siempre parece estar en el objetivo final de cerrar las ofertas, lo que hace fácil pasar por alto los pasos cruciales que vienen antes, durante y después de la venta. Pero, la realidad es, conocer las cosas correctas para hacer en todos los pasos del proceso es lo que nos establece para el éxito. Ya sea que usted está empezando o está buscando mejorar sus habilidades de ventas, este libro de la experta de la industria Rana Salman es una guía de inicio a fin que le llevará rápidamente hacia el rendimiento de la reducción de cuotas. Todo lo que necesitas saber está aquí, en tres partes fáciles de digerir:

PARTE I: LAS ESENCIALES exploran la base para la experiencia de ventas, proporciona información sobre los retos comunes que encuentran los vendedores, describe las características necesarias para sobresalir en las ventas, y más.

PARTE II: LAS ESENCIALES APPLIED le da herramientas específicas diseñadas para ayudarle a cerrar acuerdos y ampliar cuentas, incluyendo consejos sobre prospección, preparación y realización de reuniones de descubrimiento, sacar el máximo provecho de las reuniones de seguimiento, efectivamente a bordo de nuevos clientes, y más.

PARTE III: BEYOND THE ESSENTIALS ofrece aún más consejos prácticos sobre el lado humano de las ventas, desde tratar con el rechazo y la auto-doblación a aprender sobre tácticas específicas para ayudar a proteger su salud mental, y mucho más.

Empaquetado con consejos prácticos, herramientas útiles, evaluaciones y un toolkit, Sales Essentials es el recurso integral que necesitas para mejorar de inmediato tus habilidades y aumentar tu confianza en el camino hacia el éxito de tus ventas.

title: Leader's Guide to Presenting, The
description: The Leader's Guide to Presenting is a highly practical guide to delivering engaging and influential presentations.
translatedDescription: La Guía de Presentación del Líder es una guía altamente práctica para ofrecer presentaciones atractivas e influyentes.

title: The Best Thinking in Business Analytics from the Decision Sciences Institute
description: Today, business success depends on making great decisions – and making them fast. Leading organizations apply sophisticated business analytics tools and technologies to evaluate vast amounts of data, glean new insights, and increase both the speed and quality of decision making. In The Best Thinking and Practices in Business Analytics from the Decision Sciences Institute, DSI has compiled award-winning and award-nominated contributions from its most recent conferences: papers that illuminate exceptionally high-value applications and research on analytics for decision-making. These papers have appeared in no other DSI collection. Explore them here, and you’ll discover powerful new opportunities for competitive advantage through analytics. For all business, academic, and organizational professionals concerned with the science of more effective decision-making; and for undergraduate students, graduate students, and certification candidates in all related fields.
translatedDescription: Hoy, el éxito empresarial depende de tomar grandes decisiones y hacerlos rápidos. Las organizaciones líderes aplican herramientas y tecnologías de análisis de negocios sofisticadas para evaluar grandes cantidades de datos, obtener nuevas ideas y aumentar la velocidad y la calidad de la toma de decisiones. En The Best Thinking and Practices in Business Analytics del Instituto de Ciencias de la Decisión, DSI ha compilado contribuciones galardonadas y nominadas de sus conferencias más recientes: documentos que iluminan excepcionalmente aplicaciones de alto valor e investigación sobre analítica para la toma de decisiones. Estos documentos no han aparecido en ninguna otra colección de DSI. Explorarlos aquí, y descubrirás nuevas oportunidades de ventaja competitiva a través de la analítica. Para todos los profesionales empresariales, académicos y organizativos interesados en la ciencia de la toma de decisiones más efectiva; y para estudiantes de grado, estudiantes de posgrado y candidatos de certificación en todos los campos relacionados.

title: The Project Manager's Partner: A Step-by-Step Guide to Project Management
description: With the downsizing of businesses, project management is no longer a specialized profession but rather a set of competencies, skills, and behaviors that have general application. The work groups and individuals called on to be part-time project managers need tools that will help them plan, execute, control, and close out project events. These tools must be easily understood and usable right away, in real time. The Partner is composed of step-by-step performance tools such as checklists, worksheets, guidelines, and other valuable support materials that will help plan and work through project events. These tools are organized around 20 key action items that guide the project management process. The Partner also contains a glossary of project management terms that will establish a clear terminology for communications between project participants, as well as a set of practical instructions that support the use of project management software. The Partner is based on the established best practices in the field, as featured in the Project Management Institute's Body of Knowledge (PMBOK).
translatedDescription: Con la reducción de las empresas, la gestión de proyectos ya no es una profesión especializada sino un conjunto de competencias, habilidades y comportamientos que tienen aplicación general. Los grupos de trabajo y los individuos llamados a ser administradores de proyectos a tiempo parcial necesitan herramientas que les ayuden a planificar, ejecutar, controlar y cerrar eventos de proyectos. Estas herramientas deben ser fácilmente comprensibles y utilizables de inmediato, en tiempo real. El Socio está compuesto por herramientas de rendimiento paso a paso, como listas de verificación, hojas de trabajo, directrices y otros materiales de apoyo valiosos que ayudarán a planificar y trabajar a través de eventos de proyectos. Estas herramientas se organizan alrededor de 20 elementos de acción clave que guían el proceso de gestión del proyecto. El Partner también contiene un glosario de términos de gestión de proyectos que establecerá una terminología clara para las comunicaciones entre los participantes en los proyectos, así como un conjunto de instrucciones prácticas que apoyan el uso de software de gestión de proyectos. El Socio se basa en las mejores prácticas establecidas en el campo, como se muestra en el Órgano de Conocimiento del Instituto de Gestión de Proyectos (PMBOK).

title: Purpose & Impact
description: Aimed at senior professionals who are seeking new challenges, this book is the first to provide clear guidance on how to rethink and relaunch careers that align with wider purpose and societal impact.
translatedDescription: Con el objetivo de los profesionales de categoría superior que buscan nuevos retos, este libro es el primero en proporcionar una orientación clara sobre cómo repensar y relanzar las carreras que se alinean con un propósito más amplio y el impacto social.

title: Selling Solutions Isn’t Enough
description: Rather than trying to sell standardized products or services to the biggest possible set of buyers, B2B companies need to develop ways to help specific customers achieve better outcomes. Instead of describing their solutions, companies first need to understand customers’ specific challenges, objectives, operating practices, and competitive environment, then create offerings to deliver value within a customer’s specific business context and culture.
translatedDescription: En lugar de tratar de vender productos o servicios estandarizados al mayor conjunto posible de compradores, las empresas B2B necesitan desarrollar maneras de ayudar a clientes específicos a lograr mejores resultados. En lugar de describir sus soluciones, las empresas primero necesitan entender los retos específicos de los clientes, objetivos, prácticas operativas y entorno competitivo, y luego crear ofertas para ofrecer valor dentro del contexto y la cultura empresarial específicos del cliente.

title: Devices of the Soul (Hardcover)
description: "Self-forgetfulness is the reigning temptation of the technological era. This is why we so readily give our assent to the absurd proposition that a computer can add two plus two, despite the obvious fact that it can do nothing of the sort--not if we have in mind anything remotely resembling what we do when we add numbers. In the computer's case, the mechanics of addition involve no motivation, no consciousness of the task, no mobilization of the will, no metabolic activity, no imagination. And its performance brings neither the satisfaction of accomplishment nor the strengthening of practical skills and cognitive capacities."In this insightful book, author Steve Talbott, software programmer and technical writer turned researcher and editor for The Nature Institute, challenges us to step back and take an objective look at the technology driving our lives. At a time when 65 percent of American consumers spend more time with their PCs than they do with their significant others, according to a recent study, Talbott illustrates that we're forgetting one important thing--our Selves, the human spirit from which technology stems.Whether we're surrendering intimate details to yet another database, eschewing our physical communities for online social networks, or calculating our net worth, we freely give our power over to technology until, he says, "we arrive at a computer's-eye view of the entire world of industry, commerce, and society at large...an ever more closely woven web of programmed logic."Digital technology certainly makes us more efficient. But when efficiency is the only goal, we have no way to know whether we're going in the right or wrong direction. Businesses replace guiding vision with a spreadsheet's bottom line. Schoolteachers are replaced by the computer's dataflow. Indigenous peoples give up traditional skills for the dazzle and ease of new gadgets. Even the Pentagon's zeal to replace "boots on the ground" with technology has led to the mess in Iraq. And on it goes.The ultimate danger is that, in our willingness to adapt ourselves to technology, "we will descend to the level of the computational devices we have engineered--not merely imagining ever new and more sophisticated automatons, but reducing ourselves to automatons."To transform our situation, we need to see it in a new and unaccustomed light, and that's what Talbott provides by examining the deceiving virtues of technology--how we're killing education, socializing our machines, and mechanizing our society.Once you take this eye-opening journey, you will think more clearly about how you consume technology and how you allow it to consume you."Nothing is as rare or sorely needed in our tech-enchanted culture right now as intelligent criticism of technology, and Steve Talbott is exactly the critic we've been waiting for: trenchant, sophisticated, and completely original. Devices of the Soul is an urgent and important book."--Michael Pollan, author of The Omnivore's Dilemma: A Natural History of Four Meals and The Botany of Desire: A Plant's Eye View of the World"Steve Talbott is a rare voice of clarity, humanity, and passion in a world enthralled by machines and calculation. His new book, Devices of the Soul, lays out a frightening and at the same time inspiring analysis of what computers and computer-like thinking are doing to us, our children, and the future of our planet. Talbott is no Luddite. He fully understands and appreciates the stunning power of technology for both good and evil. His cool and precise skewering of the fuzzy thinking and mindless enthusiasm of the technology true believers is tempered by his modesty, the elegance of his writing, and his abiding love for the world of nature and our capacity for communion with it. "--Edward Miller, Former editor, Harvard Education Letter"Those who care about the healthy and wholesome lives of children can gain much from Steve Talbott's wisdom. He examines the need to help children spend more time touching nature and real life and less touching keyboards. He eloquently questions the assumption that speeding up learning is a good thing. Is, after all, a sped-up life a well-lived life? Most importantly, he reminds all of us that technology is just one part of life and ought not to overshadow the life of self and soul."--Joan Almon, Coordinator, Alliance for Childhood"One of the most original and provocative writers of our time, Steve Talbott offers a rich assortment of insightful reflections on the nature of our humanity, challenging our own thinking and conventional wisdom about advances in technology."--Dorothy E. Denning, Department of Defense Analysis, Naval Postgraduate School, Monterey, CA"Are you experiencing growing unease as computational metaphors have seized our discourse? Steve Talbott offers immediate relief. You are not losing your mind! Chapter after chapter, he shows how to draw on the powers of technology without losing your soul or breaking your heart."--Peter Denning, Past President of ACM, Monterey, California"Steve Talbott is a rare writer whose words can alter one's entire perception of the world. He is our most original and perceptive defender of the wholeness of life against the onslaught of mechanism. Devices of the Soul is written with Talbott's typical grace and clarity. It displays a quality hardly found anymore in our high tech culture--wisdom. "--Lowell Monke, Associate Professor of Education, Wittenberg University
translatedDescription: "El perdón es la tentación reinante de la era tecnológica. Es por eso que tan fácilmente damos nuestro consentimiento a la absurda proposición de que un ordenador puede añadir dos más dos, a pesar del hecho obvio que no puede hacer nada de la clase, no si tenemos en mente algo remotamente parecido a lo que hacemos cuando agregamos números. En el caso del ordenador, la mecánica de adición no implica motivación, conciencia de la tarea, no movilización de la voluntad, no actividad metabólica, no imaginación. Y su rendimiento no trae satisfacción de la realización ni fortalecimiento de habilidades prácticas y capacidades cognitivas. "En este libro perspicaz, el autor Steve Talbott, programador de software y escritor técnico se convirtió en investigador y editor del Instituto de la Naturaleza, nos desafía a retroceder y echar un vistazo objetivo a la tecnología que impulsa nuestras vidas. En un momento en que el 65 por ciento de los consumidores estadounidenses pasan más tiempo con sus PCs que con sus otros significativos, según un estudio reciente, Talbott ilustra que estamos olvidando una cosa importante: nuestros seres, el espíritu humano del que la tecnología se deriva. Ya sea que estamos entregando detalles íntimos a otra base de datos, esquivando nuestras comunidades físicas para redes sociales en línea, o calculando nuestro valor neto, libremente damos nuestro poder a la tecnología hasta, dice, "llegamos a la vista de un ordenador del mundo entero de la industria, el comercio y la sociedad en general...una web cada vez más tejida de la lógica programada". La tecnología digital ciertamente nos hace más eficientes. Pero cuando la eficiencia es el único objetivo, no tenemos manera de saber si vamos en la dirección correcta o incorrecta. Las empresas reemplazan la visión guía con la línea inferior de una hoja de cálculo. Los profesores son reemplazados por el flujo de datos del ordenador. Los pueblos indígenas abandonan las habilidades tradicionales para la boquilla y la facilidad de los nuevos gadgets. Incluso el celo del Pentágono de sustituir "boots on the ground" por la tecnología ha llevado al desastre en Irak. Y sigue así. El peligro final es que, en nuestra voluntad de adaptarnos a la tecnología, "descienderemos al nivel de los dispositivos computacionales que hemos diseñado, no simplemente imaginando nuevos y más sofisticados autómatas, sino reduciéndonos a los autómatas. "Para transformar nuestra situación, necesitamos verlo en una luz nueva y no acostumbrada, y eso es lo que Talbott proporciona examinando las virtudes engañosas de la tecnología, cómo estamos matando la educación, socializando nuestras máquinas y mecanizando nuestra sociedad. Una vez que usted tome este viaje de apertura visual, usted pensará más claramente sobre cómo usted consume la tecnología y cómo usted permite que la consuma. " Nada es tan raro o tan necesitado en nuestra cultura tecnificada ahora mismo como una crítica inteligente de la tecnología, y Steve Talbott es exactamente el crítico que hemos estado esperando: trichant, sofisticado y completamente original. Dispositivos del Alma es un libro urgente e importante."—Michael Pollan, autor del dilema de The Omnivore: Una historia natural de cuatro comidas y la botánica del deseo: una vista de ojos de plantas del mundo"Steve Talbott es una voz rara de claridad, humanidad y pasión en un mundo entrometido por máquinas y cálculos. Su nuevo libro, Dispositivos del Alma, establece un espantoso y al mismo tiempo inspirador análisis de lo que nos están haciendo ordenadores y pensamientos computarizados, nuestros hijos y el futuro de nuestro planeta. Talbott no es Luddite. Comprende y aprecia plenamente el impresionante poder tecnológico tanto para el bien como para el mal. Su frío y preciso recortamiento del pensamiento borroso y el entusiasmo insensato de la tecnología verdaderos creyentes se ve templado por su modestia, la elegancia de su escritura, y su amor persistente por el mundo de la naturaleza y nuestra capacidad de comunión con él. "--Edward Miller, ex editor, Harvard Education Letter "Aquellos que se preocupan por la vida sana y sana de los niños pueden ganar mucho de la sabiduría de Steve Talbott. Examina la necesidad de ayudar a los niños a pasar más tiempo tocando la naturaleza y la vida real y menos teclados conmovedores. Elocuentemente cuestiona la suposición de que acelerar el aprendizaje es algo bueno. ¿Es, después de todo, una vida de crecimiento una vida bien vivida? Lo más importante, nos recuerda a todos que la tecnología es sólo una parte de la vida y no debe sofocar la vida de sí mismo y de alma."--Joan Almon, Coordinador, Alianza para la Infancia "Uno de los escritores más originales y provocadores de nuestro tiempo, Steve Talbott ofrece una rica variedad de reflexiones perspicaces sobre la naturaleza de nuestra humanidad, desafiando nuestro propio pensamiento y sabiduría convencional sobre los avances tecnológicos."-Dorothy E. Denning, Departamento de Análisis de Defensa, Escuela de Postgrado Naval, Monterey, CA"¿Estás experimentando un creciente malestar como metáforas computacionales han tomado nuestro discurso? Steve Talbott ofrece un alivio inmediato. ¡No estás perdiendo la cabeza! Capítulo tras capítulo, muestra cómo aprovechar los poderes de la tecnología sin perder tu alma o romperte el corazón."--Peter Denning, presidente pasado de ACM, Monterey, California"Steve Talbott es un escritor raro cuyas palabras pueden alterar toda la percepción del mundo. Él es nuestro defensor más original y perceptivo de la totalidad de la vida contra la embestida del mecanismo. Los dispositivos del Alma están escritos con la gracia y claridad típicas de Talbott. Muestra una calidad que apenas se encuentra más en nuestra cultura de alta tecnología - sabiduría. "--Lowell Monke, profesor asociado de Educación, Universidad Wittenberg

title: Know Your Shoppers (Collection)
description:
In Inside the Mind of the Shopper, world-renowned retail consultant Dr. Herb Sorensen, Ph.D. uncovers the truth about the retail shopper and rips away the myths and mistakes that lead retailers to miss their greatest opportunities. Every year, says Sorensen, shoppers will spend a quadrillion seconds in supermarkets and they'll waste 80% of that time. Drawing on Sorensen's breakthrough second-by-second analysis of millions of shopping trips, this book reveals how consumers actually behave, move, and make buying decisions as they move through supermarkets and other retail stores. Sorensen presents powerful, tested strategies for designing more effective stores, improving merchandising, and driving double-digit sales increases. He identifies simple interventions that can have dramatic sales effects, and shows why many common strategies simply don't work. You'll learn how to appeal to the "quick trip" shopper, make the most of all three "moments of truth," understand consumers' powerful in-store migration patterns, improve collaboration between manufacturers and retailers, learn the lessons of Stew Leonard's and other innovators, and much more. Then, in Part II, Sorensen presents revealing interviews with several leading in-store retail experts, including crucial insights on using technology and retailing to multicultural communities.

¿

The world's #1 guide to retail success, complete with crucial, up-to-date insights--including new case studies, ideas, strategies, and tactics from today's best retailers, like TopShop, IKEA, and Best Buy. Smart Retail incorporates several valuable chapters, including:

Opportunities to learn from past retail pioneers: simple yet effective strategies your competitors have forgotten.

How to use data to drive profit and growth.

How to do more with less, and maximize the value each team member brings to the table.

How to use new technology to develop highly productive, innovative "Remote Teams."

Covering everything from creating the ultimate retail experience to understanding the customer and the importance of motivated workers, this is the book that will equip managers, teamworkers, retail entrepreneurs and indeed anybody who sells direct to customers, with practical winning ideas and strategies.
translatedDescription:
En el interior de la mente del comprador, el consultor minorista de renombre mundial Dr. Herb Sorensen, Ph.D. descubre la verdad sobre el comprador minorista y arranca los mitos y errores que llevan a los minoristas a perder sus mayores oportunidades. Cada año, dice Sorensen, los compradores pasarán un cuarto de millón de segundos en supermercados y perderán el 80% de ese tiempo. Basándose en el análisis de segundo por segundo de Sorensen de millones de viajes de compras, este libro revela cómo los consumidores realmente se comportan, se mueven y toman decisiones de compra a medida que pasan por supermercados y otras tiendas minoristas. Sorensen presenta estrategias potentes y probadas para diseñar tiendas más eficaces, mejorar la merchandising y conducir aumentos de ventas de doble dígitos. Identifica intervenciones sencillas que pueden tener efectos dramáticos de ventas, y muestra por qué muchas estrategias comunes simplemente no funcionan. Aprenderás a apelar al comprador de "quick trip", aprovechar al máximo los tres "momentos de la verdad", entender los poderosos patrones de migración de los consumidores, mejorar la colaboración entre fabricantes y minoristas, aprender las lecciones de Stew Leonard y otros innovadores, y mucho más. Luego, en la Parte II, Sorensen presenta entrevistas reveladoras con varios expertos minoristas líderes en la tienda, incluyendo información crucial sobre el uso de la tecnología y la venta al por menor a comunidades multiculturales.

¿Qué?

La guía #1 del mundo para el éxito minorista, completa con ideas cruciales y actualizadas, incluyendo nuevos estudios de casos, ideas, estrategias y tácticas de los mejores minoristas de hoy, como TopShop, IKEA y Best Buy. Smart Retail incorpora varios capítulos valiosos, incluyendo:

Oportunidades para aprender de los pioneros minoristas anteriores: estrategias simples pero eficaces que sus competidores han olvidado.

Cómo utilizar datos para impulsar el beneficio y el crecimiento.

Cómo hacer más con menos, y maximizar el valor que cada miembro del equipo aporta a la tabla.

Cómo utilizar la nueva tecnología para desarrollar equipos de remoteo altamente productivos e innovadores.

Cubrir todo desde la creación de la experiencia minorista definitiva para comprender al cliente y la importancia de los trabajadores motivados, este es el libro que equipará a los gerentes, los trabajadores de equipo, los empresarios minoristas y, de hecho, a cualquiera que vende directamente a los clientes, con ideas y estrategias de ganancia práctica.

title: Step Back
description:
How to find clarity amid the turbulence of work and life

We all wish we had more time to pause and reflect about small decisions and big goals—and everything in between. But since we live and work in a vortex of tasks, meetings, decisions, and responsibilities, we rarely get the chance to step back.

In this practical guide, bestselling author and Harvard Business School professor Joseph Badaracco argues that you don't need long periods of solitude and tranquility to reflect well. In fact, reflection can take place in the cracks and crevices of your very busy life, and these moments can help you understand your feelings, look at problems from different perspectives, focus on what really matters, and, ultimately, lead a better life.

Building on candid interviews with over a hundred executives and professionals, as well as on the classic works of Marcus Aurelius, Michel de Montaigne, and Ignatius of Loyola, Badaracco offers simple, customizable principles and ideas for reflection that lend a gentle discipline to an otherwise nebulous process.

Concise, smart, and pragmatic, Step Back is the guide you need to make reflection a positive force in your work and life.
translatedDescription:
Cómo encontrar claridad entre la turbulencia del trabajo y la vida

Todos deseamos tener más tiempo para pausar y reflexionar sobre pequeñas decisiones y grandes metas, y todo lo que hay entre ellos. Pero como vivimos y trabajamos en un vórtice de tareas, reuniones, decisiones y responsabilidades, rara vez tenemos la oportunidad de retroceder.

En esta guía práctica, autor bestselling y profesor de Harvard Business School Joseph Badaracco argumenta que usted no necesita largos períodos de soledad y tranquilidad para reflejar bien. De hecho, la reflexión puede tener lugar en las grietas y grietas de tu vida muy ocupada, y estos momentos pueden ayudarte a entender tus sentimientos, mirar problemas desde diferentes perspectivas, enfocarte en lo que realmente importa, y, en última instancia, llevar una vida mejor.

Basándose en entrevistas con más de cien ejecutivos y profesionales, así como en las obras clásicas de Marcus Aurelius, Michel de Montaigne e Ignacio de Loyola, Badaracco ofrece principios y ideas simples y personalizables para la reflexión que otorgan una disciplina suave a un proceso de otro tipo nebuloso.

Conciso, inteligente y pragmático, Step Back es la guía que necesitas para hacer de la reflexión una fuerza positiva en tu trabajo y vida.

title: Curve Benders
description:
A personal growth roadmap guiding you into the future of relationships in work, life, play, and giving 

Curve Benders is a personal growth roadmap. It will guide you through the complicated intersection of work, life, play, and giving. Countless new forces will shape the future, so the strategic relationships we form in these areas of life are, of necessity, changing. This book will show you how to move into the future and dramatically alter your growth trajectory in both its direction and ultimate destination. David Nour, the author of Relationship Economics and a top thought leader on business relationships, has identified 15 forces that will heavily influence what we do and how and where we engage our current and prospective relationships to create value and make a difference in the lives of others. 

 This book aims to provide you with a step-by-step guide for personal, professional, and organizational growth. The author highlights how certain relationships enable a non-linear growth trajectory. These relationships, in addition to augmenting what we can accomplish, often shape who we become. These relationships are “curve benders,” and this book will show you who and where they are, how to find and engage them, and, equally valuable, how you can become a curve bender to impact the lives and livelihoods of others profoundly. 

Gain insight into the value of your current strategic relationships and how they help you achieve your work, life, and giving goals 
Reconceptualize relationships to identify the people with the power, not only to help you achieve but to change who you become 
Learn how to become a “curve bender” who makes an outsized impact in the lives of others 
Become better at finding and engaging people, navigating the 15 forces that are reshaping our world 

This book is about strategic relationship planning, personal growth, and, ultimately, about you. Read Curve Benders to launch yourself into your best future.

Curve Benders es una hoja de ruta de crecimiento personal. Te guiará a través de la complicada intersección de trabajo, vida, juego y dar. Este libro pretende proporcionarle una guía paso a paso para el crecimiento personal, profesional y organizacional. title: Learning Agility: Unlock the Lessons of Experience
description: Experience is vital for a leader's success, but merely having an experience (such as a challenging new job, a stretch assignment, or an unexpected hardship) isn't enough. The best leaders know not just how to seek out developmental experiences, but how to extract the essential lessons within each experience and apply them to future situations. This book will walk you through a four step process for making the most out of your experiences. You will learn how to seek out beneficial experiences, make sense out of both old and new experiences, internalize the most useful lessons from each experience, and apply those lessons to new, unfamiliar, and challenging situations. By becoming learning agile, you'll be able to use the lessons of experience to meet the challenges headed your way.
translatedDescription: La experiencia es vital para el éxito de un líder, pero simplemente tener una experiencia (como un nuevo trabajo desafiante, una asignación de tramos o una dificultad inesperada) no es suficiente. Este libro te guiará a través de un proceso de cuatro pasos para aprovechar al máximo tus experiencias. Aprenderás a buscar experiencias beneficiosas, tener sentido tanto de experiencias antiguas como nuevas, internalizar las lecciones más útiles de cada experiencia, y aplicar esas lecciones a situaciones nuevas, desconocidas y desafiantes. Al llegar a aprender ágil, podrás utilizar las lecciones de experiencia para hacer frente a los retos que te encaminan.

title: Sales Is a Team Sport
description:
We see teamwork in every sphere of business, so why should sales be any different?

Sales is a critical part of any business, whether it’s for survival or to grow and scale. Often salespeople are seen as independent hunters and farmers working to serve their company, but that would be wrong. Salespeople may be the tip of the spear when it comes to winning business, but great sales success is built on teamwork.

This book sets out to identify the key components and helps the reader understand what it takes to build the best team from people, skills, processes, technology, and systems. Broken down into chapters that cover everything from the sales process and managing opportunities, to the important role played by marketing, and why CRM is not just a piece of software.

Sales is a team sport. Like all team sports there are those that play on the field and those that work to help the team perform. In any organization everyone plays a part. In the field of sales, understanding how this all comes together will not only help any company, but also anyone that reads the book and wants to get more out of their role, or move their business forward and achieve greater sales success as a team.

The book is filled with personal anecdotes and real-life examples from the author’s career in sales.

A menudo los vendedores son vistos como cazadores independientes y agricultores que trabajan para servir a su empresa, pero eso sería incorrecto. Los vendedores pueden ser la punta de la lanza cuando se trata de ganar negocios, pero el éxito de ventas se construye en el trabajo en equipo.

Este libro se establece para identificar los componentes clave y ayuda al lector a entender lo que se necesita para construir el mejor equipo de personas, habilidades, procesos, tecnología y sistemas. Derribado en capítulos que cubren todo desde el proceso de ventas y la gestión de oportunidades, hasta el importante papel desempeñado por el marketing, y por qué CRM no es sólo un pedazo de software.

Las ventas son un deporte de equipo. Como todos los deportes de equipo hay aquellos que juegan en el campo y los que trabajan para ayudar al equipo a realizar. En cualquier organización todo el mundo juega un papel. En el campo de las ventas, entender cómo todo esto se une no sólo ayudará a cualquier empresa, sino también a cualquiera que lea el libro y quiere sacar más de su papel, o mover su negocio hacia adelante y lograr un mayor éxito de ventas como equipo.

El libro está lleno de anécdotas personales y ejemplos de vida real de la carrera del autor en ventas.

title: How to Be Great at the Stuff You Hate: The Straight-Talking Guide to Networking, Persuading and Selling
description:
You have to do it. . . you might as well enjoy it

No one likes a pushy, smarmy salesman – no one wants to be that guy. . .but most of us need to sell to some extent. How else can we get any business? We all have to do it now, whether we're lawyers, accountants or start-ups. But don't despair – there's no need to go on some cringey sales training day. How to be Great at the Stuff You Hate shows you how to develop all the skills you need to sell yourself, your business and your ideas. So ditch the dread, forget the fear and start enjoying yourself! Selling isn't something you 'do' to people, it's not some dark art practised by pushy and manipulative people – it's a process, it's a relationship. . .it's fun! All you need to do is cut the crap, be yourself and win some business.

How to be Great at the Stuff You Hate shows you how to:

Pull together a target list – who do you want to approach and do business with?

Connect with those people – writing letters/emails

Master meeting and networking – conquering small talk!

Follow up once you've chatted to someone

Ask for what you want

Todos tenemos que hacerlo ahora, ya sean abogados, contadores o start-ups. Pero no te desesperes – no hay necesidad de ir en algún día de entrenamiento de ventas de cringey. Cómo ser grande en el Stuff You Hate te muestra cómo desarrollar todas las habilidades que necesitas para venderte, tu negocio y tus ideas. title: Cultivating an Entrepreneurial Mindset
description:
This book will help business/MBA students, aspiring and emerging entrepreneurs, executives, and leaders to think like entrepreneurs in 12 critical focus areas.

Both success and failure start in the mind. From Tamiko’s years of practical experience in coaching entrepreneurs, she has uncovered the #1 reason that some of her clients succeeded while others failed: mindset. This book will help business/MBA students, aspiring and emerging entrepreneurs, executives, and leaders to think like entrepreneurs in 12 critical focus areas.

Readers will uncover hidden thoughts that sabotage success as an entrepreneur. The author will cause you to experience a paradigm shift from an employee mindset to an entrepreneurial mindset. The text provides takeaways and practical action items to cultivate entrepreneurial thinking that will revolutionize the approach to business.

title: Strive
description:
Stop chasing happiness and seek fulfillment instead

Strive shakes up everything you know about happiness, turns you around, and sets you on the track to true fulfillment. It's not what you think—happiness is not found in achievement and luxury and having all the free time in the world. Humans are most fulfilled and feel best about themselves when they are striving towards a difficult goal that involves struggle and discomfort.

 Dr. Adam Fraser is a peak performance researcher who helps people strive for ’better’ in everything that they do; in this book, he shares his insights into the human condition and why happiness always feels just out of reach. Whether you're looking to boost workplace productivity, or just need the motivation to go about your daily life, this book will show you the little-known truths about happiness, purpose, and fulfillment.

In working with groups from all around the world, Dr. Fraser has observed that the unhappiest and most unfulfilled people have low levels of struggle and challenge. Too much comfort robs them of a sense of purpose; they have nothing to strive for, because everything is fine the way it is. This book takes you inside the root of human motivation to show you how to live and work toward fulfillment.

Grow and evolve through embracing discomfort
Reframe struggle as an opportunity for development
Learn the three behaviours of striving effectively
Discover your motivation—and use it
Learn why you are most proud of overcoming the hard things in life

When you're working toward a goal, you are engaged, motivated, and ready to take on the world. Once you achieve your goal, your happiness plummets—because nothing is left to strive for—unless you set your next goal right away. Strive provides the roadmap, and shows you how the joy is in the striving—not the destination.
translatedDescription:
Deja de perseguir la felicidad y busca el cumplimiento en su lugar

Strive sacude todo lo que sabes sobre la felicidad, te da la vuelta, y te pone en la pista para el verdadero cumplimiento. No es lo que piensas: la felicidad no se encuentra en el logro y el lujo y tener todo el tiempo libre en el mundo. Los humanos se cumplen más y se sienten mejor cuando se esfuerzan por alcanzar un objetivo difícil que implica la lucha y la incomodidad.

El Dr. Adam Fraser es un investigador de alto rendimiento que ayuda a las personas a esforzarse por ’mejor’ en todo lo que hacen; en este libro, comparte sus ideas sobre la condición humana y por qué la felicidad siempre se siente fuera de alcance. Si usted está buscando para aumentar la productividad del lugar de trabajo, o simplemente necesita la motivación para ir sobre su vida diaria, este libro le mostrará las verdades poco conocidas sobre la felicidad, propósito y cumplimiento.

Al trabajar con grupos de todo el mundo, el Dr. Fraser ha observado que las personas más infelices y más insatisfechas tienen bajos niveles de lucha y desafío. Demasiado confort los roba de un sentido de propósito; no tienen nada por qué esforzarse, porque todo está bien de la manera que es. Este libro te lleva dentro de la raíz de la motivación humana para mostrarte cómo vivir y trabajar hacia el cumplimiento.

Crecer y evolucionar a través de la incomodidad
Rechazar la lucha como oportunidad para el desarrollo
Aprender los tres comportamientos de esforzarse eficazmente
Descubre tu motivación y utilízala
Aprende por qué estás más orgulloso de superar las cosas difíciles en la vida

Cuando estás trabajando hacia una meta, estás comprometido, motivado y listo para tomar el mundo. Una vez que alcanzas tu objetivo, tu felicidad se desploma, porque no queda nada por hacer, a menos que establezcas tu próximo objetivo de inmediato. Strive proporciona la hoja de ruta, y le muestra cómo la alegría está en el esfuerzo - no el destino.

title: How to Matter Where You Work
description:

Work at a higher level: understand the bigger picture, so you can start shaping it!

Only a humble cog in a huge machine? If you can’t step back and see what the whole machine is up to, you can’t play your role well. If you only talk in terms of your cog and your neighboring cogs, bolts, shafts, and pistons, everyone will think you belong neatly where you are. But you have aspirations. Don’t you?

Trabajar en un nivel superior: entender la imagen más grande, por lo que puede empezar a configurarla!

¿Sólo un humilde engranaje en una máquina enorme? Si no puedes retroceder y ver lo que está tramando toda la máquina, no puedes jugar bien tu papel. Si sólo hablas en términos de tu engranaje y tus cognos vecinos, pernos, ejes y pistones, todos pensarán que perteneces perfectamente donde estás. Pero tienes aspiraciones. ¿No?

title: Selling with Noble Purpose: How to Drive Revenue and Do Work That Makes You Proud
description:
Does Your Sales Force Have A Purpose?

(Or do you just sell stuff?)

Shadowing hundreds of salespeople for a double-blind study on performance, sales leadership consultant Lisa McLeod made a significant discovery: Salespeople driven by a sense of purpose wildly outperformed those driven by quotas.

McLeod noticed that superstars didn't look at their quotas and ask, "How can I meet them?" They looked at their customers and asked, "How can I help them?" In McLeod's groundbreaking sales management book you'll discover why...

Driving Revenue Is Not The Purpose Of A Sales Force. It's The Test Of Its Effectiveness

Stellar performers don't just "sell stuff." They want to have an impact on their customer's lives. In her brilliant sales book, McLeod shows sales management leaders how to cultivate a sense of "noble purpose" in their team. First, by knowing that...

Overemphasizing Profit Erodes Your Bottom Line

When spreadsheets are more important than the customer's condition, problems escalate for your sales team:

title: Lead

Instead of taking the left-brain approach of "paradigm shifts" and "leadership models," the author focuses on right-brain constants such as emotional connection, compassion, focusing on others, humility, and managing oneself. title: The Five Secrets You Must Discover Before You Die
description: Based on a highly acclaimed public television series, this book takes the reader on a heartwarming and profound journey to find lasting happiness. John Izzo interviewed over 200 people, ages 60-106, who were identified by friends and acquaintances as “the one person they knew who had found happiness and meaning.” From town barbers to Holocaust survivors, from aboriginal chiefs to CEOs, these people had over 18,000 years of life experience between them. He asked them questions like, What brought you the greatest joy? What do you wish you had learned sooner? What ultimately mattered and what didn't? Here Izzo shares their stories—funny, moving, and thought-provoking—and the Five Secrets he learned from listening to them. This book will make you laugh, bring you to tears, and inspire you to discover what matters long before you die.

title: Who Do You Want to Be When You Grow Old?
description: Our later years need not be a time of loss. This book helps readers embrace the positive possibilities of aging and provides guidance on doing so purposefully, with courage, compassion, and curiosity.None of us know for sure what will happen as we age. What Richard J. Leider and David A. Shapiro do know, however, is that a purposeful mindset is a fundamental component of a life well-lived. What Do You Want to Be When You Grow Old? invites readers into the experience of two lifelong friends taking on the courageous conversation of aging well with honesty and purpose. In the first half of the book, readers are introduced to a framework for looking back over their lives and examining how they've arrived at the place they have. In the second half, readers are invited to look forward to purposeful aging with courage, compassion, and curiosity. In their bestseller Repacking Your Bags, Leider and Shapiro defined the good life as “living in the place you belong, with people you love, doing the right work, on purpose.” This book argues that aging well can be similarly defined as “aging in the place you belong, with people you love, doing the right ‘work,' on purpose.”

Shapiro saben, sin embargo, es que una mentalidad deliberada es un componente fundamental de una vida bien vivida. ¿Qué quieres ser cuando creces viejo? invita a los lectores a la experiencia de dos amigos de toda la vida tomando la valiente conversación de envejecimiento bien con honestidad y propósito. En la primera mitad del libro, los lectores se introducen en un marco para revisar sus vidas y examinar cómo han llegado al lugar que tienen. En la segunda mitad, se invita a los lectores a mirar adelante a un envejecimiento deliberado con coraje, compasión y curiosidad. En su bestseller Repacking Your Bags, Leider y Shapiro definieron la buena vida como “vivir en el lugar que perteneces, con personas que amas, haciendo el trabajo correcto, a propósito”. title: Co-Create
description: Successfully moving an organization forward is a complex task. Historically professional organizations, like the Project Management Institute, have done a fine job of providing best practices and technical tools to support project managers in the field. These tools will continue to be critical in the future. The opportunity now is to add to that body of knowledge by addressing, more completely, the human experience. In reviewing the literature, practitioners and academics alike have noted that committed teams play an important role in creating exceptional project outcomes. What has been missing is the connection between what’s known about employee engagement and commitment, from a general management perspective, and a practical method to integrate that knowledge with project management tools. This book will provide a comprehensive map for project managers to learn about the human experience during a project. It will present specific practices for generating commitment that can be easily incorporated by project managers. The Co-create Model presents a conceptual understanding and a method not currently found in the literature.
